text:
lee: Quick blocker on PR #4261. Migration guide says default `batch_size` for embeddings=512 but runtime team says hosted default is 256. Reviewers won't approve until we reconcile.

maya: Which snippet exactly? I saw one in /docs/guides/embeddings.md showing batch loop examples.

lee: Yep, that one. Example shows:
```py
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='rwi-embed-1', inputs=records, batch_size=512)
```

oliver: Runtime confirmed: hosted inference default is 256 to keep latency predictable. Some larger Dedicated pools negotiated 512 in contract templates, which likely caused the older docs copy.

maya: Ok so docs should not claim global default 512. Options: update example to set batch_size=256 or add a note about Dedicated overrides. What do reviewers prefer?

docs-ci-bot: Preview build failed for https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4261 due to `api-surface mismatch: embeddings.batch_size default` error.

aaron: Prefer explicit in-snippet values so readers get reproducible behavior. Set it to 256 in the public docs and add footnote: "Some Dedicated/private deployments may default to different batch sizes per contract."

lee: I'll change the snippet to 256 and add the footnote. Also include a short migration note: "If you upgraded from older Dedicated templates that assumed 512, check contract settings or set batch_size explicitly."

maya: Sounds good. @oliver can you paste the infra note or link so I can reference it in the PR? Reviewers want an authoritative pointer.

oliver: Pasted infra note: infra/notes/2026-03-embeddings-batching. Use that.

docs-ci-bot: Re-run queued for https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4261  publishing preview when ready.

lee: Pushed changes (256 + footnote + infra link). Tagging @maya for final review.

maya: Reviewing now. If preview passes I'll approve. Thanks for the quick sync.
